build_encodec_package: build the encodec package by running python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel
install_encodec_from_source: install encodec from source by running pip install -e . in the project root
install_encodec_dev_deps: install encodec development dependencies by running pip install -e .[dev]
run_encodec_cli: run the encodec CLI tool by invoking encodec from the command line
review_setup_config: review the encodec setup.py to check package metadata and dependencies
